summary: Climber fell on the final pitch of Lone Eagle Peak (~7 miles from Monarch Lake, Indian Peaks Wilderness), SPOT activation with serious injuries; Flight for Life located climbers and flew GCSAR members in; Black Hawk from Buckley AFB with Rocky Mountain Rescue hoist techs completed hoist before sunset; patient to Granby Airport then Flight for Life.
location: Lone Eagle Peak, Indian Peaks Wilderness
notes: Source: Grand County SAR Facebook page. Three posts document the same incident.
